answer_1.quote: We tackle the unified generation problem through fine-tuning conditional GPT-2.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates both normal chit-chat responses and transition sentences to proactively switch from chit-chat to task-oriented dialogue.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate generated chit-chat responses, Distinct-1 (Dis-1) and Distinct-2 (Dis-2) are used... To evaluate generated task-oriented responses, two N-gram matching metrics, BLEU and Meteor are used... BERTScore is also utilized... Transition accuracy detects whether the generated response at transition turn includes the [TRANSITION] special token.
